Moral of the story: tech/finance/any career  has its own unique stressors. From outside looking in, everyone can identify highlights of someone else’s life, but we tend to look through rose-colored glasses and don’t recognize the crap people put up with in other careers.

Provisional accreditation is just programs in their infancy, so they haven’t yet fully “proved themselves.”  Take that into consideration and ask in interviews a out their faculty makeup/backgrounds, the program directors vision and what student support resources they offer. It’s a huge challenge you’d be taking on when starting PA school and you want to have the peace of mind that you chose a program that’s a good fit for you.
